section2_classification.rootCauseLocation: lib/contract-model/compiler/semantic/compile.ts:217 - callerInput is built with operativeSourceText = the WHOLE resolved operative region of the candidate (for 1.01 the entire 353,523-char definitions section, 379 definitions) plus the whole frozen inventory; the candidate is the section, and nothing between discovery and the caller bounds the unit of compilation by size or by structure
section2_classification.rootCauseStatement: The unit of model work is the discovered candidate section, whatever its size. Every other observed symptom (B, C, D, E, F, G) is a consequence of or is amplified by that single fact: because the unit is the section, the context bundle duplicates the section (B), the inventory rendered is the section's whole inventory (C), the submission is the section's whole IR in one tool call (D, E), one failure loses the section (F), and the run-level cost cap has no per-unit view (G).

consequences.name: REDUNDANT_CONTEXT_DUPLICATION
consequences.evidence: 00: contextBundle.operativeTextDuplicatedByBundleItem=true for all three units; the bundle's OPERATIVE_SOURCE item (context-retrieval/structural-context.ts:137) is the candidate's own text, rendered again by caller.ts summarizeContextBundle - 353,523 of 888,779 first-turn chars for 1.01 (39.8%)
consequences.statusInF7A: removed in the shard input (buildShardCompilerInput drops OPERATIVE_SOURCE bundle items); not changed in the monolithic path (§21/§22: unchanged)

consequences.name: UNBOUNDED_INVENTORY_RENDERING
consequences.evidence: 00: FROZEN_INVENTORY 108,557 chars for 6.08 (288 items), 85,945 for 9.04 (218 items) - the largest single component for the two structural units
consequences.statusInF7A: a shard renders only its OWNED items (6.08: max 63 per shard at the chosen budget)

consequences.name: WHOLE-UNIT_SINGLE-SUBMISSION_ATOMICITY
consequences.evidence: the F-1 protocol expects one submit_compilation carrying every rule/definition of the unit; 1.01 recorded 0 rules / 0 definitions after 60,318 output tokens

consequences.name: OUTPUT_CONCENTRATION
consequences.evidence: 379 definitions x ~2,500 output tokens ≈ 949k output tokens against a 128,000 max_tokens setting (caller.ts:83)
consequences.statusInF7A: max estimated output per shard at the chosen budget: 41,500 tokens (16 units)

consequences.name: STREAM_FAILURE_LOSES_WHOLE_UNIT
consequences.evidence: 1.01: one protocol error (HTTP 400 'tool_use ids were found without tool_result blocks', on the continuation turn after 582 s) => status FAILED, 0 objects, $1.23 spent on the turn ($2.04 for the unit incl. Pass A); nothing of the 60,318 output tokens survived
consequences.statusInF7A: a shard failure is isolated to that shard; other shards' results are kept; retry addresses only the failed shard by hash. The exact trigger of the 400 is a transport/protocol question outside F-7A (cannot be reproduced without a model) and is left to F-1/F-7B

consequences.name: COST_GUARD_BLIND_TO_PER-UNIT_BURDEN
consequences.evidence: 9.04: 'BUDGET_EXHAUSTED before compile:turn: spent $13.9612 + est $0.2875 > cap $14.00' - the run-level cap tripped AFTER 1.01 had consumed $2.04 for nothing; there is no per-unit pre-call estimate that could refuse or split a 312k-token call
consequences.statusInF7A: every shard carries a pre-call estimate (input + output tokens) computed before any call; an oversized must-link block is flagged, never silently sent

notSelectedAsRoot.H_OTHER: no evidence of a defect outside A-G; the 6.08 PARTIAL (38 rules) at 95,786 first-turn tokens shows the same code path works when the unit happens to be small enough

section3_notSolvedByRaisingLimits: Raising max_tokens or the cost cap changes none of A-G: the unit stays the section, the duplication stays, the inventory rendering stays, one submission still carries everything, and one failure still loses everything. A 1.01-sized unit needs ~949k output tokens - no setting reaches that. Limits were not changed in F-7A.
section4_boundedArchitectureProperty: For every candidate, every model call has a bounded primary input (<= maxPrimaryChars of source, <= maxUnitsPerShard units), bounded read-only context (<= maxContextChars), bounded rendered inventory (owned items only), and a bounded expected output (estimateOutputTokens), all computed deterministically from the frozen source + frozen inventory BEFORE any call; the union of shard outputs is stitched deterministically; global completeness is decided only by the global Pass C over the full frozen inventory; a partial failure yields PARTIAL/REVIEW_REQUIRED, never COMPLETED.

section16_budgetEvidence.inference: The only recorded call that returned a composition had a first turn of 95,786 input tokens and 62,142 chars of raw submission; the 312k-token call returned nothing. The per-shard target is therefore set so that the LARGEST shard of the largest known unit renders well under the size that succeeded, with output an order of magnitude under the ceiling.
